+

+               b"    + FullyQualifiedErrorId : CommandNotFoundException\r\n \r\n"

     assert actual == expected
 
@@ -74,6 +76,35 @@ def test_parse_clixml_multiple_elements():
     assert actual == expected
 
 
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('encoded, expected', [
+    (b'_x000D__x000A_', b'\r\n'),
+    (b'_x263A_', '\u263a'.encode()),
+    (b'_xD83D__xDE00_', '\U0001f600'.encode()),
+    (b'_x005f_', b'_'),
+    (b'_x005F__x000A_', b'_\n'),
+    (b'_x005F_', b'_x005F_'),
+    (b'_x005G_', b'_x005G_'),
+    (b'_xD83D_', '\ud83d'.encode('utf-8', 'surrogatepass')),
+    (b'_xDE00_', '\ude00'.encode('utf-8', 'surrogatepass')),
+])
+def test_parse_clixml_escapes(encoded, expected):
+    data = b'<Objs><S S="Error">' + encoded + b'</S></Objs>'
+    assert _parse_clixml(data) == expected
+
+
+def test_parse_clixml_empty_and_filtered_elements():
+    data = (b'<Objs><S S="Info">ignored</S><S S="Error" />'
+            b'<S S="Error"></S></Objs><Objs><S S="Info">also ignored</S></Objs>')
+    assert _parse_clixml(data) == b''
+
+
+def test_parse_clixml_concatenates_within_blocks_and_separates_blocks():
+    data = (b'<Objs><S S="Error">first</S><S S="Info">ignored</S>'
+            b'<S S="Error">_x000D__x000A_</S><S S="Error">second</S></Objs>'
+            b'<Objs><S S="Error">third</S><S S="Error" /></Objs>')
+    assert _parse_clixml(data) == b'first\r\nsecond\r\nthird'
+
+
